        client-Java engine — synchronizer, compiler, ClassConsumer SPI, controller routing) and
        components/engine/engine-bpm-flowable (only needs to resolve client-compiled classes from
        delegate expressions). Extracted from engine-java's runtime package so engine-bpm-flowable
        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 13.13.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-micrometer-integration-tests 1.8.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds a quarkus-micrometer registry on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Metrics panel light-up: meters registered on the live composite
        MeterRegistry are read in process by the shared engine MetricsReportProvider, grouped and mapped onto
        the neutral MetricsReport, and surfaced on GET /bootui/api/metrics — while meters describing BootUI's
        own /bootui/** traffic are hidden by the shared engine MeterSelfFilter. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO Micrometer registry) so the registry-absent
        unavailable path and the registry-present capture path are each proven in isolation — the same split
        used for the SmallRye-Health-present/absent and OpenTelemetry-present/absent coverage.

        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Security Logs panel light-up: with quarkus.security.events.enabled
        the CDI security events fired on authentication/authorization are captured by QuarkusSecurityEventCapture

        GET /bootui/api/security-logs, with the panel reported available in the manifest. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which has NO security extension) so the security-absent unavailable path
        and the security-present capture path are each proven in isolation.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-datasource-integration-tests 1.8.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds a JDBC datasource (quarkus-jdbc-h2, backed by
        Agroal) on top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Database Connection Pools panel light-up:
        the live Agroal pool configuration and AgroalDataSourceMetrics read by the QuarkusAgroalConnectionPoolProvider
        are mapped into the shared HikariPool* wire contract by the engine ConnectionPoolService, the JDBC URL /
        username are masked through the shared SecretMasker, and the panel is surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/database-connection-pools/pools (plus the per-pool /snapshot route). Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO datasource, so the AGROAL capability gate
        keeps the panel unavailable) so the datasource-present and datasource-absent paths are each proven in
        isolation — the same split used for the cache-present/absent and SmallRye-Health-present/absent coverage.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-flyway-integration-tests 1.8.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-flyway + quarkus-jdbc-h2 (in-memory) on top
        of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Flyway panel light-up: the migration history read from
        the application's active io.quarkus.flyway.runtime.FlywayContainer beans by the QuarkusFlywayProvider is
        shaped by the shared engine FlywayService, and the panel is surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/flyway/migrations. Kept separate from bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which
        deliberately has NO quarkus-flyway, so the capability gate keeps the flyway panel unavailable) so the
        flyway-present and flyway-absent paths are each proven in isolation — the same split used for the
        Cache-present/absent and SmallRye-Health-present/absent coverage.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-hibernate-integration-tests 1.8.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-hibernate-orm (on an in-memory H2 database) on
        top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Hibernate (ORM mapping) advisor light-up end to end:
        the app's mapped @Entity classes are read from the EntityManagerFactory metamodel by the engine
        JpaMetamodelReader (via the capability-gated QuarkusEntityDiscovery), the shared engine HibernateScanner
        runs its curated rule registry on POST /bootui/api/hibernate/scan, and the QuarkusHibernatePropertyLookup
        maps the engine's config keys onto the quarkus.hibernate-orm.* namespace (proving, in particular, that the
        Spring-only Open-Session-in-View rule HIB-CONFIG-001 stays inert). Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO Hibernate ORM) so the ORM-absent
        not-configured path and the ORM-present scan path are each proven in isolation — the same split used for
        the SmallRye-Health and OpenTelemetry present/absent coverage.

Whether you're working on a cryptocurrency exchange, wallet application, or any other financial platform involving digital assets, the Fireblocks Official SDK simplifies the integration process and allows you to harness the power of Fireblocks' secure infrastructure. Stay ahead in the world of digital assets with this powerful SDK at your fingertips.</description>
